map.纸病（孔洞/刮痕）检测 使用指南: Paper Defect (Holes / Scuffs) Test User Guide
map.输入孔洞、刮痕等纸病类型与尺寸、数量等参数，依据GB/T 451.2等标准判定纸: Enter paper defect types such as holes and scuffs with size and count parameters, and judge paper quality grade and conformance against standards such as GB/T 451.2, helping papermaking and printing QC screen out rejects quickly.
map.外观质检中，按纸种与缺陷类型对照允收限（尺寸、密度）判定等级。: In appearance QC, judge the grade against the acceptance limits (size, density) for the paper type and defect type.
map.印刷用纸对孔洞/斑点敏感，包装用纸对刮痕/气泡容忍度不同，限值各异。: Printing paper is sensitive to holes and specks, while packaging paper tolerates scuffs and blisters differently, so limits vary.
map.整批放行前，统计单位面积缺陷数，结合单缺陷尺寸综合评级。: Before releasing a batch, count defects per unit area and grade them together with the size of each defect.
map.算例：印刷纸孔洞判定（尺寸 2.5mm，密度 8 个/m²，面积 10m²）: Worked example: hole judgement on printing paper (size 2.5mm, density 8 per m², area 10m²)
map.：印刷纸孔洞允收限：尺寸≤2mm、密度≤5 个/m²。实测尺寸 2.5mm>2（: : hole acceptance limits for printing paper: size ≤2mm, density ≤5 per m². Measured size 2.5mm > 2 (over size) and density 8 > 5 (over density) → non-conforming; this 10 m² area has about 8×10=80 defects. Formula: total defects = density × area.
map.：尺寸与密度均不超限且均在半数以内→优等品；均不超限→一等品；仅一项不超限→合格: : if neither size nor density exceeds the limit and both are within half the limit → premium; neither exceeds → first-class; only one does not exceed → conforming; both exceed → non-conforming. Rules come from the limit table for the paper type.
map.不同纸种的缺陷限值一样吗？: Are the defect limits the same for different paper types?
map.不一样。本工具内置印刷/包装/生活/工业四类限值：如孔洞，印刷纸尺寸≤2mm、密: They differ. This tool has built-in limits for four categories — printing, packaging, household and industrial. For holes, printing paper is ≤2mm and ≤5 per m², while industrial paper relaxes to ≤10mm and ≤10. Choosing the wrong paper type gives a wrong verdict.
map.尺寸和密度哪个更关键？: Which matters more, size or density?
map.都关键，但大尺寸缺陷（孔洞、气泡）对印刷断纸/外观影响更致命，通常优先卡尺寸；密: Both matter, but large defects (holes, blisters) are more fatal to print web breaks and appearance, so size is usually gated first; density reflects overall cleanliness. Exceeding both limits directly means non-conforming.
